ACT XII OF 1994
ACT XII OF 1994
FINANCE ACT, 1994
An Act to give effect to the
financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning on the
first day of July, 1994 and to amend certain laws
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th July, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 30th

1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Act may be
called the Finance Act, 1994.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
